Three video alignment screens are providec te aid in adjusting the game’s video monitor for maximum picture quality. Video monitor technical information including adjustment instructions can be found in your Cinemat system manual.

The first screen consists of a white crasshatch pattern (figure 13). This should be used to adjust screen pesition, horizontal size, vertical size and focus. Pressing the player two start button advances the display ta the next alignment screen.

The second alignment screen is used to adjust the red anc green intensity. An eight level (0-7) cealer scale is shown for each rec and green. The monitor should be adjusted sa that level black and one through sever appear as seven distinct levels. See figure 14.

The third alignment screen shows a four level blue colar scale Adjust the blue intensity so that level zero is black and level one through three show as three distinct levels of blue.
